name: nexguard-sentinel-incident-investigator
description: Retrieve and explain the latest NexGuard Sentinel circuit-breaker incident. The agent will find the most recent automatic Vault pause event, show the Base Sepolia transaction, cross-reference The Graph entity evidence, and explain in plain language why the system stopped the Vault.
author: NexGuard Sentinel / ETHOnline 2026

primaryTask.prompt: Find the latest critical incident in NexGuard Sentinel. Show the Base Sepolia transaction hash, the Basescan explorer link, and explain in plain language why the system automatically paused the Vault. Verify the evidence is consistent and report any issues.

tools.name: get_latest_incident
tools.guidance: Always call this tool first. It returns structured evidence including the Guardian.pause() transaction hash, The Graph event IDs, SHA-256 state fingerprint, and an agent_summary field. Use agent_summary as the basis of your explanation to the user.
tools.outputInterpretation: If found=false, report that no incidents have occurred yet. If found=true, extract pause_evidence.tx_hash, pause_evidence.explorer_url, trigger_cause, and agent_summary for the final response.

tools.name: verify_incident_evidence
tools.guidance: Call after get_latest_incident. Recompute evidence integrity and report issues.
tools.outputInterpretation: verified=true means payload integrity only; it does not authenticate the provider or independently verify the chain.

bazanticGateway.note: Payment prototype; no payment proof is accepted. Server requires SENTINEL_EVIDENCE_DEMO=1 for local demonstration access.
